subject: general
question: What is the total strength of elected members in the Lok Sabha?
solution:
The correct option is __**543.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lok Sabha** is also known as the **House of the People**.
 
• It's the lower house of the Parliament.
 
• Its term limit is** 5 years.**
 
• The maximum membership of the House allotted by the Constitution of India is 552.
 
• **PM Narendra Modi** is the** Leader of the House** and **Defence Minister Rajnath Singh** is the **Deputy Leader of the House**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The President of India, Rajya Sabha and Lok Sabha** are the three pillars of the Indian Legislature.
 
• **Shrim. Draupadi Murmu** is the **President of India**.
 
• **Om Birla** is the speaker of **Lok Sabha**.
 
• **Jagdeep Dhankhar **is the **Vice President of India & Chairman of the Rajya Sabha** since **11 August 2022**.
